card.name: Inside capitalized warning-heading words
card.fires_on: Word pieces in the middle of long uppercase words in boxed warning headings, such as DIS in DISORDERS or IS in RISKS. Also fires on a stray l in misspelled ADMINISTRATION headings.

modes.label: DIS in uppercase warning
modes.description: The piece DIS inside DISORDERS or DISORDER in an all-caps boxed warning title.
modes.example: WARNING: ENDOMETRIAL CANCER, CARDIOVASCULAR<< DIS>>ORDERS, AND PROBABLE D

modes.label: Mid-word in caps
modes.description: A piece in the middle of an uppercase word such as RISKS in a warning sentence.
modes.example: APY WITH GEMFIBROZIL AND an HMG-CoA REDUCTASE INHIBITOR DOES NOT OUTWEIGH THE R<<IS>>KS OF SEVERE MYOPATH

modes.label: Garbled ADMINISTRATION
modes.description: The l or I letter in the scanned-text misspelling of ADMINISTRATION in section headings.

card.plain: It fires partway through long all-caps words in boxed warning titles, like DISORDERS or RISKS.
